objective: Local validation and minimal evidenced validator fixes with regression coverage

working_model.primary_outcome: Reviewable fixes and exact validation evidence

rule_to_execution.implication: No remote operations, commits, branch switching, authority edits, policy decisions or unrelated cleanup
Reproduce malformed evidence acceptance and retain compliant controls; no runtime or approval overclaims

working_model.next_action: Run local test scripts, replay fixtures, repository lint and validators
stop_conditions: fix lacks evidence: do not implement

acceptance_tests: reproduce each code defect before fix
regression rejects invalid and retains valid inputs
run existing local tests and record failures without changing authority
